iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 75. ELEVATED: Islamabad nuclear talks COLLAPSED - US demands 20-yr enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 yrs. BREAKING: Pakistan confirms Iran WILLING for 2nd round this week. IAEA locked out 8+ months - cannot verify enrichment. IAEA DG Grossi urges 'very detailed' verification. NPT Review Conference Apr 27. Arms Control Assoc: US negotiators ill-prepared. Experts: stockpile could yield up to 10 bombs. Iran envoy says not seeking weapons-grade enrichment. Probability 42%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 75. CRITICAL: Ceasefire expires TOMORROW Apr 22. Trump: 'won't extend ceasefire' - military 'LOCKED AND LOADED.' Hormuz RE-CLOSED Apr 18 after brief reopening - IRGC fired on 3+ commercial vessels. Iran seized US-linked ship Apr 19. Oil prices extremely volatile. Iran 'retaliate soon' after US seizure. Bab al-Mandeb closure also threatened. Pakistan confirms Iran WILLING for 2nd round Islamabad talks this week. Xi calls for Hormuz to stay open. Death toll 3,375+. Probability 58%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 75. STABLE: 10-day ceasefire Day 5, mostly holding, expires Apr 26. Hezbollah not formal signatory - remains armed, claims Israeli tank destruction. Israel holds 10km buffer zone. Deal does NOT require Lebanon to disarm Hezbollah. In-principle extension agreement reported. NYT: ceasefire removes major obstacle in US-Iran talks. 2,196 killed in Lebanon. Probability 16%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Turkey urges NATO to reset US ties ahead of Ankara summit. Pushing for larger role in European defense. Joining NATO Steadfast Dart-26 exercise. Will assume NATO Air Policing in Estonia/Romania. Patriot batteries deployed. No escalation. Probability 4%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: ELEVATED: 8 India-bound ships returned from Hormuz Apr 18. IRGC fired on Indian-flagged tanker Sanmar Herald. Hormuz closure threatens India energy imports severely. Both India and Pakistan offering escorts. Diplomat: Iran war's impact on India and Pakistan severe. CFR warns India-Pakistan conflict likely in 2026. Probability 8%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 76. RISING: Finland parliament vote on nuclear weapons hosting imminent - would allow transport/possession of nuclear weapons on Finnish soil. First F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment poses threat, will force countermeasures. Finland shares 1,340km border with Russia. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Lavrov: patience 'not unlimited.' Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 38%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: CRITICAL: US intelligence confirmed by Bloomberg, CNN, Military.com: China preparing MANPADS (shoulder-fired missiles) shipment to Iran - advanced radar, air defense systems. Chinese officials deny. Analysts: China may use Iran arms as Trump-Xi summit bargaining chip re Taiwan. NYT: Iran resistance offers uncomfortable lessons for China re Taiwan. US Pacific redeployment to Middle East benefits China strategically. ISW: PRC Taiwan infiltration continues. Probability 52%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 73. RISING: Launched 5 tactical ballistic missiles from Sinpo Apr 19 - 7th test of 2026, 4th in April. Kim 'great satisfaction' over Hwasong-11 variant with high precision at 136km. Japan strongly protested. Bloomberg: Kim ramps up tests as US reportedly curbs intel to Seoul. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Polymarket: missile test by Apr 30 at 100%. Probability 16%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1178+. RISING: Russia launched one of LARGEST attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles, 16+ killed, 118+ wounded. ISW daily assessments continue. Ukraine devastating Russian oil infrastructure - 40% export capacity disabled. Zelensky: Russia chose 'Easter escalation' over ceasefire. Germany commits EUR300M + 5,000 drones. Lavrov: patience 'not unlimited.' Polymarket ceasefire by Apr 30: 0.4%. Probability 40%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: Open war continues. China-mediated Urumqi 2nd round concluded - agreed not to escalate but fighting continues at lower intensity. Pakistan mortars killed Afghan civilians during talks. Pakistan operations against Taliban to continue. China actively mediating. Probability 5%. Stable.
